answer: In a market where agents sell nectar and lagoon sensor data, an account may sponsor only after 450 ledger epochs. Its clock starts only once a sponsor admits it, so every elder descends from one tree capped at 2 newcomers per elder per 60 epochs. Each bond is 15 tokens times the sponsor subtree's size, so the 50th clone locks 750. One fraud proof slashes the whole subtree, and no bond can exit over a bridge for 450 epochs.
